text:
Ana (Sales): Hey team — Acme wants the POC to enforce strict regional processing: EU customers -> EU region, APAC customers -> APAC region. They also asked that KMS keys stay in-region. Need to confirm what's feasible for the POC and any pricing delta.

Sam (SE): We can route by tenant/geo via routing policy. For POC we can do tenant pinning to a single region per tenant. KMS in-region is supported with BYOK or us-managed CMKs in the same cloud region.

Contact_Acme: Timeline question: can we enable this before their kickoff on Mon 2026-04-05? Also concerned about logs/metadata egress.

Sam (SE): Short answer: yes, if we provision the tenant pin and KMS config this week. Logs: control plane logs (audit, billing) may be stored in our control plane region; we can route or redact sensitive payloads. Need to check retention & egress for audit datasets.

Mira (Legal): Need list of sub-processors for each region and confirmation about whether any logs (IP addresses, request headers) will leave the customer's chosen region. Also they asked for SOC2 / ISO artifacts — we can hand those off but want to confirm which data types are in-scope.

Josh (Infra): Ops note: for the POC we can spin a regional route and a region-scoped KMS key. Work required: tenant routing policy change + KMS key creation + network ACL for egress. Estimate ~24-48h work if no custom certs. If they require sub-processor-only in-region, that's trickier — some cloud infra (e.g., managed DB backups) might replicate metadata to a central control plane.

Ana (Sales): Pricing / delta ask from Acme: what do we charge for regional pin + per-region KMS + any cross-region failover? They want a POC quote under $X (redacted).

Sam (SE): Pricing breakdown (ballpark for POC): 
- Tenant pinning config: one-time setup fee $600
- Regional KMS: platform surcharge $0.02 / 1k requests + potential monthly key management fee $100/region
- Cross-region failover (optional): additional reserved capacity + egress allowance — estimate $200/month for POC scale

Contact_Acme: Can you send the exact API/flag we would toggle for region pinning? Also need to know if there is an API to check current effective region for a tenant.

Sam (SE): API snippet below (internal preview):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/123/pinning \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"region": "eu-west-1", "kms_key": "projects/acme/locations/eu-west-1/keys/rdw-key"}'
```
And to query effective route:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/123/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
```

Mira (Legal): We'll need the sub-processor list per region + attestations that backup/monitoring/metrics can be configured to avoid exporting PII off-region. If any automated backups or analytics pipelines touch data off-region, flag it.

Josh (Infra): Action items for infra: 1) confirm control-plane audit log residency options (by EOD), 2) list sub-processors involved in EU/APAC edge handling, 3) estimate work to isolate backups to region. I'll ping infra-runbook and ops team.

Ana (Sales): I'll send Acme the POC pricing outline and the API snippet. @mira_legal will follow up with compliance packet. @josh_infra please update this thread when you have the sub-processor list. :thumbsup:

deployment-bot: Deploy request queued for tenant 123 routing-change. ID: dr-240000-1. ETA: manual approval required.

Josh (Infra): Update: control-plane logs can be routed to a customer-controlled S3 in-region for the POC (saves on egress for sensitive artifacts). Sub-processors: list attached in follow-up DM, but primary touchpoints are: cloud-provider-managed networking, managed KMS service, metrics agent.

Contact_Acme: Great — thanks. If we can get the sub-processor list + confirmation on S3 log routing by EOD tomorrow, we'll proceed with kickoff.

Ana (Sales): Noted. Keeping timeline tight.
